#### Automated Configuration and Secure Data Ingestion with Entra Application

body.query:
let SettledAlerts = materialize(
    Halcyon_Commands_CL
    | summarize FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated) by HalcyonAlertId
    | where FirstSeen < ago(15m)
);
let LatestStatus = materialize(
    Halcyon_Commands_CL
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(15m)
    | where HalcyonAlertId in (SettledAlerts | project HalcyonAlertId)
    | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by HalcyonAlertId
    | project HalcyonAlertId, HalcyonTriageStatus, HalcyonDisplayStatus
);
SecurityIncident
| where Labels has_cs "Halcyon"
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by IncidentNumber
| where Status != "Closed"
| mv-expand AlertIds to typeof(string)
| join kind=inner (
    SecurityAlert
    | where AlertName has "Halcyon"
    | extend CustomDetails = parse_json(tostring(parse_json(tostring(ExtendedProperties))["Custom Details"]))
    | extend HalcyonAlertId = tostring(CustomDetails["HalcyonAlertId"][0])
    | where HalcyonAlertId in (LatestStatus | project HalcyonAlertId)
    | project SystemAlertId, HalcyonAlertId
) on $left.AlertIds == $right.SystemAlertId
| join kind=inner LatestStatus on HalcyonAlertId
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by IncidentName, HalcyonAlertId
| project IncidentId = IncidentName, HalcyonAlertId, HalcyonTriageStatus, HalcyonDisplayStatus

metadata.title: Halcyon-IncidentUpdate
metadata.description: Scheduled playbook that keeps open Halcyon Sentinel incidents in sync with the latest Halcyon alert states. Updates incident labels with current triage/display status.
prerequisites: 1. The Halcyon data connector must be deployed and ingesting data into Halcyon_Commands_CL.
2. The HalcyonTriggersRule analytics rule and companion automation rule must be deployed.
3. The deploying principal must have permission to create role assignments on the Log Analytics workspace.

properties.descriptionHtml:
Note: Please refer to the following before installing the solution:

• Review the solution Release Notes

• There may be known issues pertaining to this Solution, please refer to them before installing.

The Halcyon solution for Microsoft Sentinel enables you to ingest Halcyon Events and Alerts into Microsoft Sentinel using the Microsoft Sentinel Analytics Workspace.

Underlying Microsoft Technologies used:

This solution takes a dependency on the following Microsoft technologies, and some of these dependencies either may be in Preview state or might result in additional data ingestion or operational costs:

  1. Microsoft Sentinel

  2. Azure Monitor Data Collection Rules (DCR)

  3. Azure Monitor Data Collection Endpoints (DCE)

  4. Azure Log Analytics workspaces

Data Connectors: 1, Hunting Queries: 1, Playbooks: 1
